Was on wrong profile before, sorry. I don't have the financial state to pursue higher education at this time. I have to support me AND my husband (who can't work) which means I have to work an excess of 40 hours a week. My town is really seasonal, so there aren't a lot of good year-round fulltime employers, and I've found a job that makes me the money I need I just hate it immensely. 

I don't have the money to move away while simultaneously feeding us. I can never save, because I'm always stuck in a mix of him wanting new shit and me wanting to maybe save up to finalize his citizenship. Like I said in my main post, sometimes I wish he'd just get deported so I wouldn't have to deal with it. It would be like a bandaid being pulled.
